entities.name: Query protein 282 aa
observations: Sequence length is 282 aa; estimated molecular mass is 31.13 kDa.
Theoretical pI is 9.13 and estimated charge at pH 7 is +6.86, indicating a basic protein.
Pfam detects an ADK domain (PF00406) at residues 27–179, with overlapping AAA-family HMM hits.
The N-terminal region contains a P-loop-like phosphate-binding motif, FVLGGPGSGKGT, consistent with an NTP-binding kinase fold.
The C-terminal ~100 residues are lysine/serine-rich and low-complexity, suggesting a eukaryotic regulatory or targeting extension.
Best homologs are reviewed rice UMP-CMP kinases Q6K7H2 and Q7XI40, with 75.5–76.0% identity over 72% query coverage and E-values of 1e-103 to 1e-104.
Homolog annotations support pyrimidine nucleoside monophosphate kinase activity, especially UMP/CMP, using ATP as phosphate donor; exact substrate specificity remains homology-based.
Reference homologs are annotated in cytoplasm and nucleus and as monomers.
No transmembrane segment or signal peptide is indicated by the sequence-based assessment.
Sequence-derived properties do not account for post-translational modifications, processing, ligands, or oligomerization.
